# Total incomparability does not force a singular interpolation differential

Status: `literature_already_answered`

Original source: J. M. F. Castillo, W. H. G. Corrêa, and F. Cabello Sánchez,
*Differential processes generated by two interpolators*, arXiv:1908.09228,
Problem 8.10 on source PDF page 20.

Supporting answer: J. M. F. Castillo, W. H. G. Corrêa, and F. Cabello Sánchez,
*Higher order derivatives of analytic families of Banach spaces*,
arXiv:1906.06677, Section 8.1 on supporting PDF page 35 (section “A totally
incomparable family with nonsingular derivation at any point”).

The supporting paper constructs the complex-interpolation family obtained
from `(ell_infty, ell_1)` at second Rochberg order.  Its spaces are pairwise
totally incomparable, while their associated differentials are not singular
at any point.  This explicitly answers the source problem negatively.

This status packet is distinct from the existing partial-result packet for a
different question in arXiv:1906.06677.
